meta.name: using-git-worktrees
meta.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

copy.tagline: 创建隔离工作区进行特性开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在当前工作区外独立开发新功能
copy.tagline_en: Create isolated workspaces for feature development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work on a new feature without affecting your current workspace

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在开始新功能开发前自动检查是否已在隔离工作区，若没有则创建隔离工作区（优先使用原生工具，否则用 git worktree），然后安装依赖并运行测试，确保工作区干净可用。
howto.when: 当你要开始一个需要与当前工作区隔离的新功能开发，或执行实现计划之前触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能创建一个隔离工作区。
say.note: Claude 会检查当前状态并创建隔离工作区。

say.text: 我想在隔离环境中开发 feature-x，请设置。
say.note: Claude 会创建分支并设置工作区。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically checks if you are already in an isolated workspace before starting new feature work. If not, it creates one (preferring native tools, falling back to git worktree), then installs dependencies and runs tests to ensure a clean baseline.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting feature work that needs isolation from the current workspace, or before executing implementation plans.

say_en.text: Set up an isolated workspace for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will check current state and create an isolated workspace.

say_en.text: I want to develop feature-x in an isolated environment, please set it up.
say_en.note: Claude will create a branch and set up the workspace.
